task_name: SSE Router — Virtual Object State Stream

progress_update.summary: We completed Phases 1, 2, and 3 of the SSE Router implementation. Phase 1 refactored PartitionStore to own the state change channel internally (PartitionDb::new returns receiver, PartitionCell sheds all SSE state). Phase 3 refactored StateRouter to a Clone design wrapping Arc<RwLock<RouterInner>> with add_partition/remove_partition using TaskCenter::spawn + cancellation_watcher. Phase 2 wired the per-partition subscription task in SpawnPartitionProcessorTask::run() and threaded StateRouter through the entire call stack from node/src/lib.rs down to both WorkerRole and IngressRole. Workspace compiles cleanly, all 83 tests pass.
progress_update.goal: Implement GET /restate/objects/{service}/{key}/state as a text/event-stream SSE endpoint using StateRouter that caches per-object state, fans out to multiple SSE clients, maintains event history for reconnect catchup, and manages subscription lifetimes with idle timeouts. Success = endpoint streams kv-sync protocol events (RPL, ASN/DEL, CLR) with per-object revision as SSE id.
accomplished: Phase 1: PartitionDb::new() creates state_change channel internally and returns (Self, Receiver<StateChangeEvent>). PartitionCell stripped of all SSE state. PartitionStoreManager stores receivers in HashMap until taken. handle_watch_command replaces watch_service/unwatch_service.
Phase 1: WatchCommand enum added to restate-partition-store public API. test_state_change_events_via_mpsc updated to use new API via storage_test_environment_with_manager().

Phase 3: StateRouter refactored to Clone (Arc<RwLock<RouterInner>>), no store_manager field. add_partition spawns partition-router task. new() spawns state-router-cleanup task. Both select on cancellation_watcher(). subscribe() no longer lazily starts tasks.

Phase 2: SpawnPartitionProcessorTask gains state_router field. After partition_store opens, takes state_change_rx, spawns partition-subscription task (thin loop with cancellation_watcher), calls router.add_partition().

Phase 4 (partial): StateRouter::new() constructed once in node/src/lib.rs, cloned into WorkerRole and IngressRole. Threaded through Worker, PartitionProcessorManager, SpawnPartitionProcessorTask. server.rs/handler/mod.rs use Option<StateRouter> (not Arc). All Arc<PartitionStoreManager> references in ingress path removed.
progress_update.now: Just finished wiring Phase 2+3+4-partial: workspace compiles cleanly (cargo check --workspace), 83 tests pass. The SSE handler in handler/objects.rs already calls router.subscribe() — it was pre-existing from a prior session. Remaining work is Phase 4 completion (verify SSE handler works end-to-end) and Phase 5 (tests/cleanup/clippy).
next_steps: Phase 4 completion: Verify handler/objects.rs SSE handler works with new StateRouter.subscribe() signature (&self instead of self: &Arc<Self>). Check path_parsing.rs handles ObjectState route correctly.
Phase 5: Run cargo nextest run --all-features (full workspace). Run cargo clippy --all-features --all-targets --workspace -- -D warnings and fix any warnings.
Phase 5: Add/update integration tests for the SSE endpoint in server/tests/ if applicable.
Post-feature cleanup: Replace SpawnPartitionProcessorTask struct with plain function (noted in plan).
constraints: StateRouter::new() must be called from async context with TaskCenter available (spawns cleanup task).

remove_partition is implicit — when PartitionDb drops, state_change_tx closes, router task sees channel close, calls on_partition_closed naturally. No explicit remove_partition call needed in spawn task.
WatchCommand channel capacity is hardcoded to 64 in spawn_processor_task.rs (matches plan constant CMD_CHANNEL_CAPACITY).
PartitionStore must be Clone for the subscription task to hold its own instance — confirmed pre-existing.
decisions: StateRouter passed into SpawnPartitionProcessorTask as a field (no return type change) — cleaner than returning (cmd_tx, state_change_rx) from run().
remove_partition not explicitly called — natural lifecycle via channel close on PartitionDb drop handles it.
SpawnPartitionProcessorTask struct cleanup deferred post-feature (noted in plan Phase 5).
open_questions: Does handler/objects.rs need any changes for the new StateRouter.subscribe(&self) signature, or does it already work (objects.rs calls router.clone().subscribe(...))?
risks: StateRouter::new() called before roles start in node/src/lib.rs — if TaskCenter isn't fully initialized at that point, the cleanup task spawn could fail. Should verify in integration test.
